title: 史上最小多模态模型 Muse Ember 发布，1M 超长上下文专攻智能体高频任务
content:
Competition in AI open source and commercialization continues to intensify. Recently, Meta Superintelligence Labs officially released the fourth model under the Muse brand, and its smallest efficient multimodal reasoning model to date — Muse Ember. This model is built specifically for repetitive subtasks that AI agents need to handle at high frequency during everyday operation.
Core Positioning: Focused on High-Frequency Agent Subtasks, Enabling Fine-Grained Division of Labor
In Meta's product matrix, each model plays a different role. Among them, the flagship Muse Wonder focuses on tackling the most complex planning and hard problems, Muse Spark handles everyday coding and agent workflows, and the new Muse Ember focuses precisely on scaled repetitive coding and agent subtasks.
Meta explicitly states that Muse Ember's core use cases mainly cover tool calls, coding subtasks, routing, extraction, and long document parsing. Through this fine-grained division of labor, large models can support the daily operation of massive agents with greater efficiency.
Architectural Features: Native Multimodal Fusion and a Million-Token Context Window
In terms of underlying architecture and multimodal capabilities, Muse Ember demonstrates a very strong overall processing level. The model natively supports multiple input forms, including text, images, audio, and video. This means that when agents perform tasks, they do not need to call separate models; they can directly read screenshots, charts, scanned pages, voice memos, or even meeting recordings, and can even operate desktop applications directly through screenshots.
In terms of processing capacity, Muse Ember has an ultra-large context window of up to 1 million tokens, and a single call can easily accommodate a complete codebase or an entire document collection. At the same time, its maximum output length can reach 512,000 tokens, four times that of similar competitors.
It should be noted that the model uses a fully managed model, running only on Meta's managed infrastructure (namely Meta Model API and Muse Code). Its weights remain private, so it does not offer options for running on local GPUs, laptops, or quantized deployment.
Benchmarks: Stunning Performance on Agent Tasks, Slightly Behind in Code Merge Scenarios
In evaluations by authoritative testing organizations and Meta's internal test suites, with maximum inference effort enabled, Muse Ember demonstrated excellent overall performance:
Agents and workflows (Agents): In the AutomationBench-AA test based on 657 Zapier business workflows, Ember's task completion rate reached 37.8%, far ahead of GPT-6Luna's 20.2% and Claude Haiku5.5's 13.9%. In the internal Agents’ Last Exam test, Ember scored 61.6, also better than Haiku's 57.0 and Luna's 57.1.
Coding and development (Coding): In the Terminal-Bench4.0 test, Ember led with 40.9 points, ahead of Haiku's 39.2 and Luna's 16.4; it also ranked first with 46 points in the Artificial Analysis (AA) coding agent index. However, in the FrontierCode2.0-AA test, which examines code merge capability in real repositories, Haiku5.5 scored 34.9, outperforming Ember's 27.2.
Multimodal and perception: In the GDP.pdf-AA test, Ember tied with GPT-6Luna (22.8 points); on OSWorld2.1 (partial score), it held a narrow lead over Haiku with 69.5 points versus 68.9; in the tool-integrated PerceptionBench test, Ember scored 80.6, higher than Haiku's 78.6 and Luna's 62.8.
In the overall Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index, Muse Ember scored 36, exactly on par with Claude Haiku5.5 (max effort), and ahead of GPT-6Luna's 28.
Cost Efficiency: Same Base Pricing, Significantly Optimized Actual Task Costs
In terms of public API pricing, Muse Ember's standard rates are consistent with competitors: $0.10 per million input tokens, $0.50 per million output tokens, and $0.004 per million cached input tokens (lower than Haiku and Luna's $0.01).
Although the base unit price is similar, thanks to improved token consumption efficiency, the actual cost of executing a single task has been significantly optimized. Test data shows that Muse Ember's cost per task under the highest reasoning setting is about $0.136, while Claude Haiku5.5 costs as much as $0.411 to complete similar tasks, meaning its cost per task has dropped to about one-third that of its competitor.
In addition, when handling ultra-long text, competitors often double their prices or apply tiered surcharges once prompts exceed 10K or 272K, while Meta has not set up a separate long-context surcharge tier for Ember, further strengthening its cost-effectiveness in long-text processing.
Ecosystem Access and Partners
Currently, developers can officially access and use Muse Ember through Meta Model API and Meta's coding agent tool Muse Code, and it supports the standard Responses API. During the early testing phase, many well-known companies and technology platforms, including Box, Cline, Oracle, Cloudflare, and You.com, have already participated.

report.summary: Meta发布最小多模态模型Muse Ember，1M上下文专攻智能体高频任务
report.background: 随着开源与商业化竞争加剧，大模型厂商开始从「一个模型通吃」转向「模型矩阵 + 粗细分工」。Meta Superintelligence Labs 已有旗舰 Muse Wonder（复杂规划）、Muse Spark（日常编码与 agent 流程）负责处理难题，本次发布的 Muse Ember 是 Muse 品牌第四款、也是体积最小的多模态推理模型，定位为智能体日常运转中的高频重复子任务。其思路是让小模型承担大量重复调用，把昂贵的大模型留给真正困难的推理步骤，从而降低智能体规模化的单任务成本。
key_points: 定位为「可大量调用的小模型」：专注工具调用、编码子任务、路由、信息抽取、长文档解析等重复性工作，与旗舰Muse Wonder、Muse Spark形成粗细分工。
架构上原生支持文本、图像、音频、视频输入，上下文达100万token、最大输出51.2万token，单次调用可容纳完整代码库或文档集，智能体无需再串联多个专用模型。
智能体类基准表现领先：AutomationBench-AA 657条Zapier工作流完成率37.8%，远超GPT-6Luna 20.2%与Claude Haiku5.5 13.9%；综合智能指数36与Haiku持平。
在真实仓库代码合并场景（FrontierCode2.0-AA）仅27.2分，落后Haiku5.5的34.9分，说明它擅长短平快子任务而非深度工程合并。
定价$0.10/百万输入、$0.50/百万输出、缓存输入$0.004更低；因token效率更高，单任务成本约$0.136，约为Haiku的三分之一，且未设长上下文加价档。
完全托管、权重闭源，只能经Meta Model API与Muse Code调用，不提供本地GPU或量化部署；Box、Cline、Oracle、Cloudflare、You.com等已参与早期测试。
report.impact: 对行业而言，模型分层与「小模型跑量」已成明确趋势，智能体的单位任务经济性取代单纯跑分成为竞争焦点；原生多模态加超长上下文，将挤压OCR、语音转写等拼接式方案。对开发者，API单价持平但单任务成本大幅下降，适合高频agent循环；代价是闭源托管带来厂商绑定，深度编码任务仍需调用更强模型，多模型路由将成常态。对普通用户，能看截图、听会议录音、直接操作桌面应用的智能体将更便宜、更普及。
report.tools: 想跟进可先用 Meta Model API 或编码agent工具 Muse Code（支持标准 Responses API）；开源编码agent Cline、Cloudflare Workers AI、You.com 等已参与内测，可关注其接入情况；横向对比可参考 Artificial Analysis 智能指数、Terminal-Bench 与 AutomationBench 等工作流基准。
